messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE fired: network-dns-lb-health (P1) — multiple TLS handshake failures + LB target unhealthy spike across eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Pager: pagerduty-bot.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 assigned to @anna.ops (primary). Escalation policy: network-oncall -> sre-led.

anna.ops: ack'd. I'm on it. seeing error: 'tls: handshake failure' in edge-proxy logs starting 2026-03-14T09:02:10Z. Any recent cert roll? @kevin-net @maria-sre

kevin-net: Not from infra side. No cert rotation in the last 48h. Checking ALB cert config + target groups now.

maria-sre: I'm tailing ELB logs and metrics. TargetHealth reports ~40% unhealthy on frontend-targets-eu, spike at 09:02 -> 09:12. 5xx rate up in EU region.

lisa-support: Customer tickets coming in: some EU customers report 'connection failed' and completions timing out. CS triage says ~35 unique orgs affected. Flagging higher priority.

samir: Running quick dig and curl from a probe in eu-west-1:
```
$ dig +short rrset service.redwood.example.com
-> returns correct A/ALIAS
$ curl -v https://service.redwood.example.com/health
* TLS handshake error
* Connection reset by peer
```

julie-eng: If LB is returning handshake errors, could be a cipher mismatch or client hello failing due to SNI. ELB metrics show TLS handshake error count on ALB listeners jumped. Any recent TLS policy change?

kevin-net: No policy change. But I see a weird surge of SYN/REJ from a subset of edge proxies. Possibility: upstream edge instance digest mismatch after a recent kernel patch? Looking at host deployments.

maria-sre: Also seeing increased 502/503 in the request logs with the pattern: backend responded with 'upstream reset during ssl handshake'. Full sample: 
```
[09:04:12] proxy-1234 -> 10.0.8.45: TLSv1.2 handshake failed: tls: unexpected message
```

anna.ops: OK mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic away from eu-central-1 to eu-west-2 via weighted routing, 2) take affected target group out of rotation, 3) spin temporary fallback proxies with older AVX kernel build. Need quick assessment if DNS weight change will cause wider propagation delays. @kevin-net can you prepare weight change?

kevin-net: I'll prepare a Route53 weighted update with low TTL (60s) and set weight eu-west-2=95 eu-central-1=5 for the service record. Pushing to change now. I'll post change ID.

anna.ops: Also create one-off support page for customers + status note. @lisa-support, can you coordinate comms?

lisa-support: On it. Drafting status: "Partial service degradation in EU regions affecting model completions. Engineers actively investigating. No data loss." Will post once we confirm failover.

pagerduty-bot: Change acknowledged by @anna.ops. Reminder: if pager not acknowledged in 15m escalate to @maria-sre.

kevin-net: Route53 change submitted: change-id Z3X-2143-RED - TTL=60. Propagation starting. Will monitor.

maria-sre: After weight change, target health in eu-central-1 still shows unhealthy but traffic volume reduced. 5xx rate in eu-west-2 falling. Good sign.

anna.ops: Rolling back any recent proxy config? Julie, can you confirm last deploys 08:50-09:00?

julie-eng: I see a non-breaking proxy patch merged at 08:47 and deployed by canary auto-rollout at 08:55 in EU clusters. Patch touched OpenSSL minor bump. Rolling canary back to previous build in eu-central-1 now.

samir: Canary rollback executed for proxy-autoscale group in eu-central-1. Patching status: 4/6 instances rolled back so far.

maria-sre: Metrics: handshake failures down 70% in eu-central-1 after rollback and Route53 weight shift. Error rate not fully back to baseline yet.

anna.ops: Great. Keep monitoring for 30m and prepare for handoff. Pager: escalate schedule? We should keep page open until stable for 30m.

lisa-support: Posted status update to status.redwood.com and customer Slack channels. Added note about partial degradation and mitigation steps.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-0423 acknowledged. Next auto-escalation in 15 minutes.

kevin-net: Reverted weights to original after 20 minutes stable: eu-west-2=70 eu-central-1=30 while we validate. Change-id Z3X-2143-RED-2.

maria-sre: Final checks: TLS handshake error rate back to baseline, ALB target health steady. Running synthetic end-to-end health checks across EU POPs — all green.

anna.ops: Marking as mitigated for now. We'll keep incident in monitoring and do root cause investigation (RCI) tomorrow to look at the OpenSSL bump + canary gating. Thanks all. Passing to next on-call: @maria-sre for postmortem.

maria-sre: ack. I'll take the handoff and coordinate RCI. Saving logs and samples to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0423/logs.tar.gz

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem owner assigned: maria-sre.

lisa-support: Closing customer-facing note as of 09:45 UTC with link to follow-up: https://status.redwood.example.com/incidents/INC-2026-0423

anna.ops: Thanks everyone. If anything flares up, re-open the page. :thumbsup:
